forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,35 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: 8d80
+title: 'Inkling 2 MTP: compile the verify pass (sequential rows) like the one-row decode'
+---
+## Why
+^jddp2ck compiled the one-row decode only. Plain decode went from 80.7 to 101.8 tok/s, but MTP speed did not move. The verify pass is still the eager, host-bound path.
+
+Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests (Release, M5 Ultra):
+
+| | stable | with ^jddp2ck |
+|---|---|---|
+| decode L=1 | 13.55 ms | 10.48 ms |
+| verify L=2 | 12.77 ms | 12.51 ms |
+| verify L=4 | 17.33 ms | 17.43 ms |
+| verify L=8 | 26.60 ms | 27.27 ms |
+| short, plain / MTP block 3 | 80.7 / 95.5 (1.18x) | 101.8 / 95.8 (**0.94x**) |
+| long, plain / MTP block 3 | 76.7 / 116.0 (1.51x) | 94.3 / 116.1 (1.23x) |
+| chat turns, MTP | ~121 tok/s | ~121 tok/s |
+
+At short contexts MTP is now slower than plain decoding.
+
+## What
+- Trace the sequential path of `Inkling2DecoderLayer.decode`, for rows 2...16, in segments around the attention cache, as `compiledDecode` does.
+- Inside the trace: the rowwise projections, the prologue, the chained convolution states, the depth mixes, the controllers, the routed experts and the expert convolution.
+- Outside the trace: `cache.update` with the causal-rows attention, and storing the windows into `SpeculativeConvolutionCache`. Those are cache side effects.
+- The row count is part of each trace's shape, so each layer gets up to 15 shapes.
+- Then retune the per-drafter preferred MTP block against the new plain speed.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests pass: verify vs decode steps max logit difference 0.0, and MTP equal to plain over 160 tokens.
+- [ ] Verify L=2/4/8 times drop, and MTP beats plain at short contexts again.
+- [ ] MLXLMTests pass. #inkling-perf
\ No newline at end of file

@@ -1,6 +1,36 @@

 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m84k3v5ww4vn992rxwrnxqbp
+  text: |-
+    ## Result: implemented and correct, but no gain. Reverted (scratchpad/with_verify_compile.patch)
+    - I traced the verify pass as `compiledDecode`'s sequential variant: rowwise projections, chained convolution states, per-row tau, the causal-rows attend outside the trace, and windows stored for the speculative cache.
+    - Inkling2MTPIntegrationTests: verify vs decode steps max |logit diff| 0.0 at L=2/4/8, and parity equal over 160 for 3/3 prompts. Plain golden CHECK PASS.
+    - No speed change: verify L=2 12.51 → 12.38 ms, L=4 17.43 → 17.30 ms, L=8 27.27 → 27.12 ms. MTP short block 3 95.8 → 96.4 tok/s.
+
+    Why: unlike plain decode, the verify pass is GPU-bound. inklingcli `vprofile` at ctx 2k, build + eval:
+
+    | rows | total |
+    |---|---|
+    | 1 | 11.2 ms |
+    | 2 | 13.7 ms |
+    | 4 | 18.7 ms |
+    | 8 | 29.1 ms |
+
+    Each extra row routes to its own 8 experts, ~1.7 GB more expert weights, ~1.8 ms at the measured bandwidth. The compile only removes host time that was already hidden under the GPU.
+
+    ## The MTP picture after ^jddp2ck, block size re-checked (block 2 measured by temporarily setting `smallestMeasuredBlockSize = 2`; the test file is reverted)
+    | | plain | block 2 | block 3 (preferred) | block 4 |
+    |---|---|---|---|---|
+    | short (31 tok) | 102.8 | 103.7 (1.01x) | 95.9 (0.93x) | 85.0 (0.83x) |
+    | long (5077 tok) | 95.3 | 108.4 (1.14x) | 116.6 (1.22x) | 111.0 (1.16x) |
+    | chat turns, block 3 | ~100 | – | ~121 (1.2x) | – |
+
+    - The preferred block stays at 3. MTP's absolute speed is unchanged against stable: short 95.5 → 95.9, long 116.0 → 116.6, chat ~121 → ~121. Plain decoding caught up.
+    - Making MTP pay again at short contexts needs a cheaper verify on the GPU. Each verify row reads its own 8 experts, so drafts that the target accepts more often matter more than the host overhead.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-23T16:16:36.540744+00:00
 position_column: doing
 position_ordinal: '80'
